A1.justification: Both PDFs describe TRACED and contain complete main text and Appendices A–S. Text extraction and rendered-page comparisons support reliable comparison of the equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v4 reports original training, zero-shot evaluation, and ablation results on MiniGrid and BipedalWalker, plus multi-agent JaxNav experiments in Appendices Q and S.

after.justification: v5 retains the original MiniGrid, BipedalWalker, and JaxNav experimental results, including benchmark comparisons and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same PVL-plus-ATPL regret estimate, Co-Learnability calculation, ranked task sampling, and replay/mutation procedure. The networks and losses in Appendix H.3 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same twelve MiniGrid evaluation mazes, PerfectMazeLarge and PerfectMazeXL, six BipedalWalker terrains, and multi-agent JaxNav scenarios. No training or evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: DR, PLR⊥, ADD, and ACCEL remain in the main comparisons; ACCEL-CENIE remains in the BipedalWalker return comparison; SFL and Robust PLR remain in Appendix Q.

E3.justification: The reported training budgets, PPO worker counts, evaluation episodes, metrics, normalization, and testing procedures are unchanged, including the JaxNav protocol and supplementary experimental settings.

E4.justification: The component, weight, and worker-count ablations; long-horizon runs; curriculum and trajectory analyses; and Co-Learnability shadow-testing analysis are all retained unchanged in Section 4 and Appendices A–E and S.

E5.justification: Reported seed and run counts, mean-plus-standard-error tables, 95% confidence intervals, and Appendix S correlation tests and p-values are unchanged. No statistical reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: Matched numerical entries and plotted findings are unchanged throughout. For example, Table 11 retains TRACED’s 10k MiniGrid mean solved rate of 0.66 ± 0.03, and Table 14 retains its 10k BipedalWalker mean return of 89.95 ± 12.95.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and regret decomposition are unchanged. Appendix R retains identical assumptions, coupling-based transition loss, Lemma 1, Theorem 1, and proofs; equation movement reflects pagination only.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning transition-aware regret, Co-Learnability, sample efficiency, zero-shot generalization, and scalability.

C2.justification: Interpretations of ATPL-driven complexity growth, Co-Learnability transfer, and long-horizon oscillations are unchanged. Appendix L retains the same limitations concerning stochastic transitions, heuristic weights, estimator quality, and applicability.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hardware, software versions, hyperparameters, training times, and code-access information are unchanged. The new acknowledgments credit funding and computing providers without adding technical settings or access instructions.

R1.justification: The reference list and research positioning in the introduction and Appendices I–K are unchanged, including distinctions from ACCEL, CENIE, and learnability-based approaches.

P1.justification: v5 adds corresponding-author marks and a footnote for Sejin Kim and Sundong Kim, an acknowledgments section, and publication-header text. Project-link spacing is adjusted; scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Conference headers and the author footnote accompany limited text and float reflow. Figure 9 moves from page 8 to page 9, and nearby displays shift. Figure and table content and designs remain unchanged; appendix page bodies match visually.

improvement.justification: v5 adds publication and attribution information and makes minor layout adjustments. The scientific exposition, experimental evidence, theory, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged across the main text and appendices, establishing no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
